quotations.old_english: For generenesse heora freónda, ðara ðe of weorulde leordan
quotations.latin: pro ereptiōne suōrum qui de sæculo migrāvērant

source_text: ge-nerenes, -ness, e; f. A taking away, deliverance; ereptio :-- For generenesse heora freónda, ðara ðe of weorulde leordan pro erepti&o-long;ne su&o-long;rum qui de sæc&u-short;lo migr&a-long;v&e-short;rant, Bd. 4, 22; S. 592, 26. Ginerenis ereptio, Rtl. 30, 5.
